profile.headline: Associate Software Engineer
profile.summary: Currently working as an Associate Software Engineer at SEL. When not in work, you can find me training for Ironmans, marathons, and triathlons; trying not to get run over on my motorcycle; running 911 calls on the local ambulance; skiing; or exploring the Northwest with my dog hiking, paddleboarding, rock climbing and backpacking.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: Working as an associate full-stack software engineer at SEL in Pullman.

positions.title: Product Designer
positions.description:
Worked on  product design for a recruiting SaaS platform. Make mockups, conduct  user research, and plan  interface design.
Conduct user interviews and feedback sessions with clients to identify usability issues and feature requests along with our Head of Product. Take feedback and turn it into reality by changing designs and making new features for our product.
Create detailed wireframes, prototypes, and designs in Figma and Miro and help the engineering team with questions or implementation of  these designs .
Do daily standups with our engineers to answer questions about the product or make decisions on how to move forwards.
Analyze platform usage metrics with PostgreSQL and Metabase, running SQL queries to track our recruiting team’s progress, identify bottlenecks or areas to work on, and inform design improvements for our recruiting process.
Design and publish CMS-driven web pages for our website MilitaryHire.
Produce tutorial videos and help guides to help onboard new customers and users.

positions.title: Hiring Assistant
positions.description:
Recruited for open positions for clients using LinkedIn, Indeed, and our own job board. 
Interviewed jobseekers, communicated with account managers and clients, and created job postings.
Managed applicant data pipelines using Excel and ATS systems.
Conducted candidate screening and video interviews.

positions.title: Emergency Medical Technician (Seasonal Contract)
positions.description: Part-time seasonal contract EMT for the Gorge Ampitheatre in Washington State. Provide BLS emergency healthcare to to almost 28,000 people weekly at the concert venue and campground.

positions.title: Systems and Support
positions.description:
Conducted property research using mapping tools  and spreadsheets.
Used Trello and Asana for organization
Created reports on properties, called county offices to discuss available properties.
Analyzed property data in target states, identify promising areas to purchase.
Mail purchasing agreements to counties, handle initial property purchase screening, use tools like Google Earth Pro to review the property. 
Communicated via email with clients and landholders about payments, tracked late and failing payments, and worked with customers to understand our system.

positions.title: Human Resources Intern
positions.description:
Digitized and reorganized HR data systems
 Built and presented Excel-based analytics reports for hiring trends.
Created reports and presentations based on analysis of data on tight deadlines.
Presented these reports to the team and discussed how to implement improvements based  the information, filed and stored sensitive information on employees on a regular basis.
Created and sent offer/raise/promotion letters;  worked with Excel spreadsheets to track finances and hiring activity; scheduled interviews and onboarding meetings.
Tracked upcoming terminations, work anniversaries, and hires; managed library and organized books; processed new hire and termination information.
Created and handed out onboarding packets for new hires, helped update HR processes; and worked with the Lever hiring system to recruit potential candidates.
Transitioned to more of a part time role after the summer internship period had ended, but eventually had to leave as I was in high school and couldn’t balance work and school.

volunteerExperiences.description: Substitute teach kids in elementary, middle school, and high school on an as-needed basis.

Responding to 911 trauma and medical calls for Moscow and Latah county EMS. Provide BLS patient care and support. Do paid contract IFT and standby events with the department as the need arises. Represent department at safety, community, or training events.
